كُوْثَرٌ : see كَثِيرٌ, in three places. ＝
-A2- A lord, or master, (S, K,) abounding in good: (S:) a man possessing good, or much good, and who gives much or often; as also ↓ كَيْثَرٌ . (K, TA.) ＝
-A3- A river. (Kr, K.) ―
-b2- And الكَوْثَرُ A certain river in paradise, (S, Msb, K,) from which flow all the [other] rivers thereof, (K,) pertaining specially to the Prophet, described as being whiter than milk and sweeter than honey and as having its margin composed of pavilions of hollowed pearls. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
